title: Essay paragraphs need a number to refer to (2026-11-24)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
We need a consistent way to number paragraphs for reference. 
Agents reference a paragraph number, but I can't see the number anywhere.

The numbers can appear in the layer view, and aslo with the paragraph title. 

Numbers should be dynamic - rearranging paragraphs changes the numbers.

sections.name: source
sections.label: Source
sections.content: The owner, in conversation with Claude Code, 2026-11-24, asking for paragraph numbers in the srs-web essay editor; recorded verbatim.
